title: Storage Budget v1
description: Storage budget policy for Rig Relay's local .build/rig-relay/ artifact tree. Defines retention windows, sampling rates, and capacity thresholds that gate fleet/delegate execution.

warn_local_mb.description: Storage threshold in MB that triggers a warning. Default: 1024 (1 GB).

max_local_mb.description: Hard cap in MB for local storage. Compaction is blocked above this threshold. Default: 2048 (2 GB).

refuse_fleet_over_mb.description: Storage threshold in MB above which fleet/delegate execution is refused. Default: 4096 (4 GB).

max_bundle_mb.description: Maximum telemetry bundle size in MB. Default: 250.

max_chatgpt_bundle_mb.description: Maximum ChatGPT dev bundle size in MB. Default: 512.

raw_observability_days.description: Retention period for raw observability JSONL files in days. Default: 3.

raw_tool_artifacts_days.description: Retention period for raw coordination artifacts in days. Default: 3.

coordination_events_days.description: Retention period for coordination events.jsonl in days. Default: 14.

stale_leases_hours.description: Age in hours after which a coordination lease is considered stale. Default: 24.

desktop_projection_snapshots_days.description: Retention period for desktop projection snapshots in days. Default: 1.

telemetry_bundle_zip_days.description: Retention period for telemetry bundle zip files in days. Manifest is kept permanently. Default: 7.

derived_jsonl_days.description: Retention period for derived JSONL datasets in days. Default: 30.

parquet_rollups_days.description: Retention period for parquet rollup files in days. Default: 365.

keep_all_failures.description: If true, retain 100% of failure events regardless of sampling. Default: true.

keep_all_refusals.description: If true, retain 100% of refusal events regardless of sampling. Default: true.

keep_all_conflicts.description: If true, retain 100% of coordination conflict events regardless of sampling. Default: true.

keep_all_checkpoint_refusals.description: If true, retain 100% of checkpoint refusal events regardless of sampling. Default: true.

sample_success_rate.description: Fraction of successful tool calls to retain. Default: 0.05.

max_semantic_snippets_per_session.description: Maximum semantic change snippets retained per session. Default: 200.

max_command_events_per_session.description: Maximum command events retained per session. Default: 5000.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the storage budget configuration.
